chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: 'James Bond Car Collection Eaglemoss lot' and 'James Bond Car Collection 35 unopened' (last 90 days, sold only; separate single cars, sub-lots of 10+ and full sets). Also eBay AU sold 'Eaglemoss Bond Car Collection sealed magazine'; check price per car for sealed vs cased. Also LiveAuctioneers/Invaluable 'James Bond Car Collection Eaglemoss' for Australian auction results. Single-car checks: eBay sold for rarer issues (Aston Martin DB5 no.1, Lotus Esprit, Vanquish).
viewing_check: Count the issues and confirm they are mostly still sealed with magazines; note any issue numbers in the 50s plus (later, scarcer) and whether the Vanquish and any other cars are loose cased. Check for damage to cases or bags, and that the box holds no duplicates. The sealed set count is the main driver.
